windows.reason: PLUMED's build system for the GPU plugin is Linux-only, so the obstacle is the platform rather than the GPU. It requires autotools (autoconf/automake, absent on the Windows host) and emits POSIX shared objects loaded via dlopen; configure.ac detects only .so and .dylib and has no Windows .dll / LoadLibrary path. Making PLUMED's plugin mechanism work on Windows is upstream build-system work, far outside this port's minimal footprint. Confirmed on windows-gfx1101 and windows-gfx1201. NOTE for the approver: approving this alone does NOT make plumed2 PR-ready -- wave32 is also unsatisfied at head and still needs a gfx1100 run. Because plumed2 cannot build on Windows at all, the wave32 gate cannot be carried by this Windows host and must come from a Linux RDNA machine.

Not buildable on Windows without an upstream build-system port.
